curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the three school bus light signals and the divided-road rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per light signal; contrast card for hazard, yellow overhead and red overhead lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what each bus light requires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach yielding on right and left turns, left turns on red between one-way and two-way streets, and what a green light does not give you.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Turn and green-light cards; contrast card for what green does not override.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who yields during turns.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach stop signs and flashing reds, four-way stops, broken signals, flashing yellow arrows, T-intersections and YIELD signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per intersection type; contrast cards for tie-breaks and arrows versus flashing reds.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who goes first at described intersections.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach yielding to workers and service vehicles, emergency vehicles, merges and funeral processions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Situation cards; contrast card for funeral procession rights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on special right-of-way cases.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach every situation where pedestrians get the right of way, including green lights and unmarked crosswalks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per pedestrian rule; contrast card for green lights and pedestrians.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pedestrian right of way.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when and how to pass on two-lane roads, returning to your lane, extra care cases, being passed, and passing on the right.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Passing technique cards; contrast card for legal right-side passing versus the shoulder.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on safe passing decisions.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach each no-passing situation: markings and signs, hills and curves, distances near crossings, and stopped vehicles and buses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: No-passing cards; contrast cards for two hundred versus one hundred feet and the center turn lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described pass is allowed.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: School bus signals, right of way and passing

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
